name: definition-list
summary: Presents stable entity metadata as a responsive semantic definition list.

agent.useWhen: A detail view presents one entity's stable metadata or configuration values.
agent.avoidWhen: Users compare repeated records across columns or the content is prose.

contract.role: native dl with paired dt and dd values
invariants: One to 100 items; terms are nonblank plain text and all serialized values are control-free text.
Rich values are admitted only through the host-owned rich-value path; serialized JSON never carries raw HTML.
Responsive narrow layouts stack terms above values; no content is hidden or truncated.
Fragment slots are exactly [[attributes]] and [[items]], filled as escaped text except explicit admitted values.
